`spec.consistentHash` support has been added to `TrafficPolicy` and committed on the `feat/consistent-hash` branch.

### Summary of Changes
1. **API & CRD Definitions** ([traffic_policy_types.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go), [zz_generated.deepcopy.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/zz_generated.deepcopy.go), [gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/install/helm/kgateway-crds/templates/gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml)):
   - Added [`ConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L161-L186) to [`TrafficPolicySpec`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L47-L157) with sub-fields `disable`, `headers` ([`ConsistentHashHeader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L189-L202) and [`ConsistentHashRegexRewrite`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L205-L214)), `cookies` ([`ConsistentHashCookie`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L217-L239) and [`ConsistentHashCookieAttribute`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L242-L251)), `queryParameters` ([`ConsistentHashQueryParameter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L254-L263)), `filterState` ([`ConsistentHashFilterState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L266-L275)), and `sourceIp` ([`ConsistentHashSourceIp`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L278-L282)).
   - Added CEL validation enforcing that no other `consistentHash` fields may be set when `disable` is `true`.

2. **IR Construction, Route Translation & Policy Merging** ([consistent_hash.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go), [constructor.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/constructor.go), [traffic_policy_plugin.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go), [merge.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go)):
   - Implemented [`constructConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L93-L238) to build Envoy `RouteAction_HashPolicy` entries in canonical type order (`headers`, `cookies`, `queryParameters`, `filterState`, `sourceIp`), deduplicating by identifying key (case-insensitively for headers while preserving first-occurrence casing), parsing cookie TTLs in Go duration or integer seconds format, passing cookie attributes through, and configuring header `regexRewrite`.
   - Implemented [`applyConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L258-L271) to default empty `{}` configurations to a single `sourceIp` policy (`terminal=false`) and suppress hash policies when `disable: true`.
   - Implemented [`mergeConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go#L625-L673) and [`mergeConsistentHashPolicies`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L273-L353) to union array fields across policies in priority order, deduplicate by key, re-sort into canonical type order, retain the higher-priority policy's `sourceIp` value (even when unset), and record `consistentHash` in merge metadata.

3. **Tests** ([consistent_hash_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_mog4_s_/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash_test.go)):
   - Added unit tests covering IR equality, validation, construction, canonical ordering, deduplication, cookie TTL parsing, policy merging, disable suppression, and CRD CEL validation.
